newsitem.title: UK: EMI's Fifield faces flak over salary.
newsitem.headline: EMI's Fifield faces flak over salary.

text.p: Jim Fifield, president and CEO of EMI Music, faced criticism over his seven million stg annual pay package at EMI Group Plc's annual meeting on Friday.

One shareholder asked how the board could justify Fifield's pay in a year when the company took a 117 million stg charge to restructure its U.S music operations. The question prompted a ripple of applause from fellow shareholders.
"Jim Fifield controls the whole (music) business and the whole business met its target," EMI chairman Sir Colin Southgate told the meeting.
EMI's annual report details Fifield's total remuneration last year as 6.99 million stg.
